children: Potential factory-floor pilot could open new opportunities for AI-powered robotics across Israel's food manufacturing industry
ROSH HAAYIN, Israel, Oct. 15, 2026
-- Ultrobotix Ltd.

(the "Company") announced today that it has begun working with an Israeli food manufacturing company to identify and evaluate suitable humanoid and other robotic technologies for potential applications in food production operations.

The initiative provides Ultrobotix with an opportunity to explore how robotic technologies may address operational challenges in food manufacturing, particularly labor-intensive production processes and tasks requiring repetitive manual work.

As part of the exploratory initiative, the manufacturing facility could potentially serve as a pilot site for evaluating robotic systems and assessing their suitability for selected production-line tasks currently performed by employees.
Any potential pilot would be subject to further technical assessments and agreement between the parties.
Potential Opportunity Beyond a Single Manufacturing Facility

The proposed collaboration is intended to examine not only the capabilities of individual robotic systems but also the practical requirements associated with introducing robotic technologies into existing manufacturing operations.
Potential areas of evaluation include integration with production equipment, food safety, workplace safety, operational reliability, and cost-effectiveness.

Information obtained from such evaluations, if undertaken, could assist Ultrobotix in assessing the suitability of similar robotic solutions for other food manufacturers facing comparable operational challenges.
In connection with its existing relationship with AIBotics, Inc.

, a company focused on AI-enabled robotics and intelligent automation, Ultrobotix expects to receive support in identifying potential robotic technologies and suppliers and evaluating solutions against the operational requirements of food manufacturing facilities.
The Humanoid Robots under consideration would be supplied by third-party robotics manufacturers.
Exploring Humanoid Robotics for Food Manufacturing Applications
Humanoid robotics is an emerging area of industrial automation, particularly in environments where certain production processes continue to rely on human labor.

Unlike traditional industrial robots, which are generally designed for fixed and specialized operations, humanoid robots are being developed to perform a broader range of tasks in environments originally designed for people.
However, the suitability of humanoid robots for specific food manufacturing applications remains subject to technical evaluation, operational testing, safety requirements, and economic feasibility.
Current Stage of Evaluation

Ultrobotix is currently in the initial stage of gathering operational information and mapping the food manufacturer's specific production-line requirements. The objective is to identify and evaluate suitable humanoid robotic technologies that could potentially perform selected tasks currently carried out by production-line employees.

This process includes assessing the nature of the required tasks, operational conditions, and technical requirements to determine whether available humanoid robotic solutions could meet the manufacturer's needs.
Ben Kaplan, Chief Executive Officer of AIBotics, commented:
"The potential for robotics extends beyond delivering food to a table. It also includes exploring how robotic technologies could support food production."

"We believe humanoid robotics may offer new opportunities for industrial automation. Our collaboration with Ultrobotix provides an opportunity to evaluate potential applications within the food manufacturing sector, where technical performance, safety, reliability, and economic considerations will determine whether these technologies can provide practical solutions."

"Should the proposed evaluations advance and demonstrate satisfactory results, the experience could help identify potential applications for robotic technologies at other food manufacturing facilities in Israel and potentially additional markets."

AIBotics' anticipated involvement builds on its existing relationship with Ultrobotix and its broader strategy of identifying and evaluating robotic technologies for commercial and industrial applications.

The initiative remains at an exploratory stage. There can be no assurance that any proposed robotic systems will be purchased or deployed, or that the activities described will result in commercial agreements or revenue for Ultrobotix or AIBotics.
Yoav Bar Joseph, CEO of Ultrobotix, commented:
“Labor shortages continue to pose significant challenges for food manufacturers, creating a growing need for innovative automation solutions.

At Ultrobotix, we have begun working with an Israeli food manufacturer to identify and evaluate humanoid and other robotic technologies for potential use in selected labor-intensive tasks on production lines.
Through our relationship with AIBotics, we aim to identify and evaluate robotic solutions that could help food manufacturers improve operational efficiency and address labor-related challenges.

We believe this initiative could provide valuable insights into the practical applications of humanoid robotics and potentially create opportunities to explore similar solutions with other food manufacturers across Israel.”
Nature of the Collaboration
The exploratory collaboration is between Ultrobotix and an Israeli food manufacturer.

AIBotics is not a party to the collaboration between Ultrobotix and the food manufacturer. Its anticipated involvement, through its existing relationship with Ultrobotix, is expected to focus on assisting in the identification and evaluation of potential third-party robotic technologies and suppliers.
The cooperation between Ultrobotix and the food manufacturer is non-binding. No purchase, installation, or commercial deployment of robotic equipment has been agreed upon or is assured.
Any potential pilot project or future commercial arrangement would be subject to satisfactory technical and economic assessments and the execution of definitive agreements.

There can be no assurance that any pilot project will begin, that robotic technologies will be successfully implemented, or that the initiative will result in commercial agreements or revenue for Ultrobotix or any other participant.
About AIBotics, Inc.
AIBotics, Inc.

focuses on AI-enabled robotics and intelligent automation solutions designed to address operational requirements across commercial and industrial markets. The Company's activities include service robotics, robotics-as-a-service offerings, and the exploration of emerging humanoid robotic technologies. Through relationships with robotics manufacturers, including KEENON Robotics, AIBotics seeks to support the selection, deployment, and operation of intelligent robotic systems.
For more information, visit www.aibotics.ai.
About Ultrobotix Ltd.

Ultrobotix Ltd. is a food technology company focused on the development of innovative food and beverage products. The Company is developing an AI agent designed to assist food scientists, technologists, chefs, and product developers in the creation and optimization of food and beverage formulations. The agent is being developed to autonomously analyze ingredient functionality, nutritional targets, sensory profiles, regulatory requirements, and manufacturing parameters in order to generate and optimize product formulations. The Company has also established a division focused on robotics solutions through collaborations with third-party manufacturers of existing technologies. This division is intended to leverage the Company's existing relationships within the food, hospitality, and service industries and is engaged in the marketing and commercialization of robotic technology solutions designed to support automation, operational efficiency, and scalable service delivery across these environments.
